<p>Dealing with rater disagreement is becoming more important in AI, especially for LLMs and in specialized domains such as health. In the past year, I helped open source two datasets allowing to study rater disagreement in the health domain: a relabeling of MedQA, a key benchmark for evaluating medical LLMs, and a dataset including differential diagnosis ratings for skin condition classification. Both are available on GitHub.</p>
<p>The post <a href="https://davidstutz.de/open-sourcing-relabeled-medqa-and-dermatology-ddx-datasets/">Open-Sourcing Relabeled MedQA and Dermatology DDx Datasets</a> appeared first on <a href="https://davidstutz.de">David Stutz</a>.</p>
